title: myCHEF vs Pinch Gourmet: which is better in 2026
body_html:
Choose myCHEF if you want a vetted private chef cooking in your own kitchen, or a catered event planned around your guest count and menu. Choose Pinch Gourmet if you have already seen its menu and format and they match your event. This page compares the two on the questions that decide a booking in 2026, and it marks where you need to check Pinch Gourmet directly. Start with myCHEF if you want a chef designed around your household.

TL;DR
  • myCHEF vs Pinch Gourmet comes down to format: a chef in your kitchen versus a caterer's set menu.
  • myCHEF suits home dining, weekly meal prep, dinner parties and corporate events, with vetted chefs and halal-first standards.
  • Pinch Gourmet suits you if its published menu and format already fit your event.
  • Neither price is quoted here. Ask both for a written quote against the same date and guest count.

Why this matters

Private chef and catering searches in Dubai mix two different products. One is a person who cooks for you at home. The other is a company that prepares and delivers food for an event. Comparing them on price alone leads to the wrong booking.

The better question is what you are buying: a cook in your kitchen, a menu delivered to your venue, or a fully staffed event. Answer that first, then compare providers. The 2026 decision is mostly about fit, not brand.

At a glance

Dimension myCHEF Pinch Gourmet
Best for Private chef at home, weekly meal prep, dinner parties, corporate events, large celebrations Confirm on their site whether their menu format fits your event
Core model Vetted chefs matched to the client; menu designed around the household or event Confirm directly
Chef vetting Chefs are vetted and scored before they cook Confirm directly
Halal approach Halal-first standards Confirm directly
Menu design Built around the client and guest count Confirm whether menus are fixed or bespoke
Event scale Household meals through to large catered celebrations Confirm maximum guest count
Kitchen cleanup Kitchen left exactly as found Confirm directly
Pricing model Quote based on menu, guest count and service Confirm directly

The rows follow the sections below. Where the Pinch Gourmet column says confirm, the information is not verified here and you should get it in writing before you decide.

myCHEF is built around the client, not a set menu

myCHEF is a private chef and catering service in Dubai. The service covers home-cooked meals, weekly meal prep, dinner parties, corporate events and large catered celebrations for households and businesses in the UAE.

The operating idea is short: a chef for your kitchen, catering for your event. Menus are designed around who is eating, how many, and what they need.

Verdict on menu flexibility: myCHEF is the stronger fit if you want a menu designed around your table. If you want to pick from a fixed list, ask Pinch Gourmet whether its offer works that way and compare it with a myCHEF proposal.

Chef vetting: myCHEF documents it, confirm the other side

myCHEF chefs are vetted and scored before they cook in a client's home. That matters most for private dining, where a stranger works in your kitchen and around your family.

Ask Pinch Gourmet how its kitchen and service staff are selected and supervised. A clear answer is a good sign. A vague one is information too.

Verdict on vetting: myCHEF has a stated process. Pinch Gourmet is unverified here.

Halal standards: both must answer in writing

In the UAE, halal is a baseline for most hosts, not a premium option. myCHEF works halal-first. Ask any caterer, Pinch Gourmet included, how it sources meat, how it separates ingredients, and what it can put in writing for your event.

Halal catering is a wider category than one provider. For a broader look at the market, read what the best halal catering companies in Dubai offer, and note how the same standards apply across markets: providers of halal catering services abroad ask the same questions about sourcing and preparation that you should ask here.

Verdict on halal: a tie on what to demand. Both should show you their standard before you pay a deposit.

Home dining and weekly meal prep

This is where the two models diverge most. A private chef shops, cooks and cleans in your kitchen, or prepares a week of meals for your household. myCHEF offers both home-cooked meals and weekly meal prep.

A delivery caterer brings food prepared elsewhere. That can work for a party. It is a different product from a chef who cooks in your home.

Verdict on home dining: myCHEF is the clear choice if you want someone cooking in your kitchen. Check what Pinch Gourmet offers for weekly household meals before treating the two as equivalent.

Events and large celebrations

For dinner parties, corporate events and large celebrations, the questions change. You need guest count limits, staffing, equipment, service style and timing.

myCHEF handles dinner parties, corporate events and large catered celebrations. Ask both providers the same list:

  • Maximum guest count for your service style
  • Whether service staff are included or extra
  • What equipment and setup are provided
  • Whether the menu can be adjusted for dietary needs
  • What is required from the venue, such as kitchen access

Verdict on events: both can be right. The deciding factor is whether the menu and service style match your event. Compare written proposals for the same date. For the wider market, see the best catering companies in Dubai.

Get a tailored myCHEF quote

Send your date, location, guest count and service required.

Request a quote

Cleanup and the host experience

A good private chef leaves the kitchen as they found it. myCHEF states that its kitchens are left exactly as found. If you are hosting, this saves the part of the evening nobody enjoys.

Ask Pinch Gourmet what happens after the meal: who clears, who packs, and whether that is included in the quote.

Verdict on cleanup: myCHEF has a stated standard. Pinch Gourmet needs a written answer.

Pricing

No prices are listed here. Prices change with menu, guest count, service style and date, and a number on this page would go stale.

The two pricing models trade off differently:

  • Per-person or set-menu pricing is predictable but less flexible.
  • Quote-based pricing built around the menu and guest count is flexible but needs a clear brief.

myCHEF quotes against your specific menu, guest count and service. For a breakdown of what drives the cost of a chef, read how much a private chef costs in Dubai. Ask Pinch Gourmet whether its quote is itemised, and whether staffing, equipment and delivery are included.

Verdict on pricing: a tie until you have two written quotes for the same brief.

If you are still comparing

If Pinch Gourmet is not the right fit, the Pinch Gourmet alternatives guide covers other options in Dubai. Compare every shortlisted provider on the same date and guest count.

Scorecard

Home dining and weekly meal prep myCHEF
Large events Tie: depends on menu and service style
Kitchen cleanup myCHEF (stated)
Pricing Tie: compare written quotes

Final verdict

Choose myCHEF if:

  • You want a vetted chef cooking in your own kitchen.
  • You need weekly meal prep for a household.
  • You want a dinner party or corporate menu designed around your guests.
  • You care about a halal-first standard and a clean kitchen afterwards.

Choose Pinch Gourmet if:

  • You have reviewed its menu and format and they match your event.
  • Its written quote covers staffing, delivery and setup for your date.
  • Its answers on halal sourcing and dietary needs satisfy you in writing.

The quotable verdict: myCHEF is the better choice in 2026 for hosts who want a vetted private chef designed around their household or event.

FAQ

Is myCHEF better than Pinch Gourmet?

myCHEF is better for a private chef in your own kitchen and for menus designed around your guests. Pinch Gourmet may suit you if its published menu matches your event. Compare written quotes for the same date.

What does myCHEF offer?

myCHEF offers vetted private chefs for home-cooked meals, weekly meal prep, dinner parties, corporate events and large catered celebrations in the UAE. Menus are designed around the client.

Is myCHEF halal?

myCHEF works to halal-first standards. For any event, ask for the sourcing and preparation detail in writing before you confirm.

How do I compare private chef quotes in Dubai?

Send every provider the same date, location, guest count and service required. Then compare what each quote includes: staffing, equipment, delivery and cleanup.

Does myCHEF publish prices?

Quotes are based on your menu, guest count and service. Ask for a written quote rather than relying on a general figure.

Can myCHEF cater large events?

Yes. myCHEF covers dinner parties, corporate events and large catered celebrations. Share your guest count when you enquire so the proposal fits.

One last thing

The most useful move is to send the same brief to both providers on the same day. Compare what each quote includes, how quickly each replies, and how clearly each answers your halal and dietary questions. The provider that answers precisely before you pay is usually the one that delivers precisely on the night.
